problem: Source says taxes do not weigh on 'those who levy them'; candidate changed to 'those who vote them', which shifts the sense (levy = impose).
replacement: In countries where the poor *e alone hold the power to make the laws, no great economy in public spending should be expected. That spending will always be considerable, either because the taxes do not fall on those who impose them, or because they are laid in such a way as not to fall on those classes. In other words, the government of the democracy is the only kind of government in which the power that imposes taxes escapes paying them.
